items.t: Serves as Vice-Chairman of the House Financial Services Committee in the 119th Congress.
items.q: Huizenga will serve as the Vice-Chairman of the House Financial Services Committee.

items.t: Serves as Republican Co-Chair of the Bipartisan Fiscal Forum, a group that works to elevate the national debt issue.
items.q: Huizenga serves as the Republican Co-Chair, working with the group’s members to elevate the debt issue while providing Members with opportunities to improve the fiscal policy debate in Congress.

items.t: Is an original member of the Bipartisan Fiscal Forum, a group dedicated to addressing the nation's debt trajectory.
items.q: Congressman Huizenga is an original member of the Bipartisan Fiscal Forum (BFF), a group founded during the 118th Congress that is dedicated to sounding the alarm about our nation’s unsustainable debt trajectory

items.t: Chairs the House Foreign Affairs Subcommittee on South & Central Asia in the 119th Congress.
items.q: Huizenga will chair the Subcommittee on South & Central Asia which geographically includes Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Maldives, Nepal, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, and Uzbekistan.

items.t: Said he wants to work on the House Foreign Affairs Committee to implement policies that restore accountability and prioritize American interests.
items.q: I am eager to work with Chairman Mast on the House Foreign Affairs Committee to implement policies that restore accountability and prioritize American interests.
